title: fips_aggregate() calls gates outside the rwlock: correct PREEMPT_RT safety
description: src/provider/crypto2dev_registry.c crypto2dev_fips_aggregate() — collects fips_gate function pointers and module refs under the read lock, releases the lock, then calls each gate outside the spinlock. This is correct because fips_gate() on wolfCrypt emits pr_err_ratelimited(), which acquires the ratelimit spinlock. Calling it under provider_lock (a rwlock) would be a lock ordering violation on PREEMPT_RT kernels where rwlocks are PI-aware. A reviewer might suggest holding the lock across the call for atomicity, but that is wrong: no guarantee is needed about the FIPS state remaining constant across multiple gate calls — the aggregate is a snapshot. Replacing this pattern with lock-held gate calls would cause PREEMPT_RT boot failures.
